newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Silicon sees Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Silicon sees Q3 loss.

text.p: Integrated Silicon Solution Inc said Thursday it expects to report a third-quarter loss between $0.25 to $0.29 per share on revenues that will be "slightly higher" than the $25.8 million of the second quarter but lower than its earlier target.

It said the third-quarter loss will include a one-time charge of $2 million to $3 million related to the establishment of a new design center in the Northwest, a writedown of certain acquired software assets, and increases in various reserves. The company was not immediately available to say what its earlier targets had been.
The company's forecast contrasts with a mean estimate among analysts for a third-quarter profit of $0.02 per share, according to First Call.

"Although business in general has been stable and we have experienced some growth, we have had a slowdown from specific customers in the disk drive and communications arenas," President and Chief Executive Officer Jimmy Lee said in a statement.
